- #3176 — marked complete
- #3177 — open (formalising synaptic IO and morphology details, e.g. mono- vs. bis-stratified, in axioms)
- #3178 — marked complete (midget ON/OFF and parasol ON/OFF)
- #3179 — open (mouse RGC nomenclature reconciliation across the two nomenclatures + literature)

I did not commit any changes against this EPIC because:

1. The two outstanding pieces of work (#3177, #3179) are themselves broad refactoring tasks rather than single atomic edits, and they have their own discussion threads / scoping decisions which should drive the implementation.
2. Without the content of those sub-issues, any RGC-related changes I made here would risk being out of scope, duplicating in-progress work, or conflicting with decisions reached in the linked discussion document.

Could the maintainers either:

- close this EPIC if both remaining sub-issues are being tracked independently, or
- point me at a specific, atomic edit you'd like me to make against this ticket (e.g. a single class to refactor, a specific axiom pattern to apply across listed RGC terms)?

Happy to pick this up again once the scope is narrowed.
